questions.question: Is thallium a toxic metal?
questions.answer: Yes. Thallium is listed by [[sources/ufelle2021-metals-chapter|Ufelle & Barchowsky 2021]] among the minor toxic metals for which toxicity has been described. The page does not provide further detail on the nature or severity of that toxicity.

questions.question: Does this page tell me how much thallium is in food or consumer products?
questions.answer: No. This is a source-map stub and does not contain any dietary occurrence data, exposure estimates, or contamination levels for thallium in food or consumer products. Substantive thallium-specific content awaits a dedicated ingest.

questions.question: What is the source behind the current thallium page?
questions.answer: The page draws on a single source, [[sources/ufelle2021-metals-chapter|Ufelle & Barchowsky 2021]], the "Toxic Effects of Metals" chapter in Casarett & Doull's Essentials of Toxicology, 4th ed. That chapter mentions thallium among minor toxic metals but does not include a detailed thallium subsection, so the page is source-map context only.
